next_tickets.body: Repeat the sorted-baseline residual timing-tail nuisance test on Sample-I runs with identical S02/S04 controls and compare transfer of the proxy coefficient signs across Sample-I and Sample-II. Expected information gain: separates a run-local pedestal recoverability diagnostic from a detector-period-specific timing artifact.
next_tickets.title: S16u: Sample-I transfer of sorted-baseline timing-tail nuisance

pre_registered.controls: pair identity, amplitude ratio/sum, peak samples, pretrigger dispersion, and S02 CFD20 raw residual
pre_registered.nuisance_proxy: absolute and signed raw-pretrigger residual of sorted hrd.baseline, with trapezoid sidebands as recoverability covariates
pre_registered.reproduction: exact S00 selected B-stave pulse count from raw h101/HRDv ROOT
pre_registered.split: leave one Sample-II analysis run out; train corrections on all other Sample-II analysis runs
pre_registered.win_rule: lowest held-out paired-bootstrap sigma68_ns among correction methods; the causal question is the paired delta between proxy-augmented and control-only fits
